_about: Public-domain John Angell James (1785-1859, Congregational minister of Carr's Lane, Birmingham, author of The Anxious Inquirer) for the Word Hoard: the Works edited by his son T. S. James (London: Hamilton, Adams, from 1860, 17 vols), raw Internet Archive OCR from Princeton scans. 16 of the 17 volumes are on the shelf; vol. 15 has no scan with a text layer. CCEL and Gutenberg hold none of it. Added 2026-10-02 by lane A, round 6 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
